# Ingestion fixtures

`basic/` is generated by `python3 -I gen_fixtures.py basic` and mirrors Claude Code 2.1.319 transcript records
(anonymized). Do not edit the JSONL by hand; change the generator and regenerate.
The JSONL is not committed: tests call `dduck_core::testkit::ensure_basic()`, which runs the generator
when a file is missing (needs `python3`).

Markers:
- `CANARY_*` — text in fields D.Duck must never store. No `CANARY_` string may appear in the DB, WAL, SHM or logs.
- `TITLEMARK_`, `PATHMARK_`, `BRANCHMARK_` — fields D.Duck may store (title, cwd, branch). They may appear only in
  `sessions.title`, `sessions.project_path`, `sessions.git_branch`, and never in logs or notification text.

Expected result of ingesting `basic/` (main session `11111111-…`):

| What | Expected |
|---|---|
| API responses | 3 (msg_B usage is written 10 → 120 → 40; max merge must give 120) — `msg_A`, `msg_B`, `msg_S` (subagent). Excluded: `<synthetic>`, API error, partial last line `msg_C` |
| Tokens | input 16, output 175, cache write 5m 30, cache write 1h 100, cache read 3000, thinking 27 |
| After a newline is appended to the main file | `msg_C` is added: input +1, output +3 |
| Tool calls | 4 — Bash, Skill, Agent, `mcp__notion__search` (MCP server `notion`) |
| Skill invocations | `openspec-apply-change` (via tool), `opsx:propose` (via slash) |
| Builtin commands | `upgrade` (via slash) |
| Not recorded as commands | `/fake` (mention in prompt), `/meta-cmd` (isMeta), `/bad name;rm` (invalid name), `/evil` (tool_result), `/attach` (attachment), `/blob` (api-request-blob) |
| Session reported cost | 5.0 (segment 1000 → 2.0, segment 2000 → 3.0) |
| Session title | `TITLEMARK_alpha` |
| Skipped lines | 1 (invalid JSON) |
| Subagent | `a1b2c3`, type `Explore`, linked to the main session |
